label: okaramy

label: chy
desc: Red claw-like root with several dangling finger tips, long pale stem making a wide loop above.

desc: Very large plant: broad dark-green leaf with scalloped edge curling down at right, long green stem, and a wide spreading bluish-green root system across bottom of page.
